name: Spirit Mascot
oracle_text: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

needs.what: a triggered-ability event that fires when one or more cards move out of a graveyard -- a DSL trigger name mapping to a graveyard-departure event that carries the owner of the graveyard (so `controller: "you"` can restrict it to your own) and batches every card that left as part of the same move into a single firing, so exiling three cards from your graveyard for one cost puts one +1/+1 counter on this creature and not three
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `trigger_events` carries `leaves_battlefield` (and `dies`, `sacrificed`), all of which are about a permanent leaving the battlefield -- the wrong zone entirely, and a card leaving the graveyard is never a permanent leaving play. `exile_from_graveyard` is a *cost* key and `return_from_graveyard` is an *op*: they are two of the ways a card leaves a graveyard, not a way to notice one, and hanging the counter off either would only cover a card's own effects, never an opponent's graveyard hate, another player's reanimation of your creature, or a flashback/escape cast that exiles on resolution. The engine's `ZONE_CHANGE` event (src/automtg/engine/events.py) does carry `from`/`to` zones and would be the natural substrate, but it is absent from `TRIGGER_EVENTS` in src/automtg/engine/triggers.py, so no DSL trigger can listen to it, and even if one could, it is emitted once per object moved, which is exactly the per-card firing the printed "one or more" forbids.
